lesson: The Write tool requires a prior Read-TOOL call on the target path; Bash cat/head does NOT count. Reading via shell then writing costs a failed tool call every time. Habit: if a file will be Written this session, Read it once with the tool.
evidence: 2026-09-04 session: 3 failed Write calls (holds.txt, attention.py, carry_forward.json) all preceded by Bash cat reads of the same paths.
